character: 300 km linked domain — Val d'Isère (Olympic heritage, X Games, 6m+ snowfall) and Tignes (largest European glacier, summer skiing, ice driving on frozen lake)
description: 300km of linked pistes between Val d'Isère and Tignes, named after legendary Olympic skier Jean-Claude Killy. Among the most snow-sure domains in Europe — both resorts are high-altitude (Val d'Isère 1,850m, Tignes 2,100m) with glaciers (Grande Motte 3,456m, Pisaillas 3,100m). Known for: exceptional off-piste, Olympic heritage (Val d'Isère hosted 1992 Olympics), year-round skiing at Tignes glacier, and consistent snow from late November to early May. Tignes has summer skiing operation June-July. 76 lifts.

stats.glacier: Grande Motte (Tignes) — largest skiable glacier in Europe, 6 km long, summer skiing May-Oct

snow_record.val_disere_avg_snowfall: 6m+ per season — micro-climate delivers consistent heavy snow
snow_record.snow_reliability: 10/10 — both resorts above 1,850 m, glacier in Tignes
snow_record.glacier_summer_skiing: Grande Motte (3,456 m) — Europe's largest accessible skiable glacier. Open June-October.

resorts.name: Val d'Isère
resorts.character: Olympic pedigree, X Games venue, legendary off-piste, 60+ restaurants, 6m+ snowfall, 3 sectors (Fornet/Solaise/Bellevarde). Most famous off-piste: Banana, Charvet Tour, Face du Charvet. Apres: Folie Douce, Cocorico, Dick's Tea Bar.

resorts.name: Tignes
resorts.character: 4 villages (Le Lac, Val Claret, Le Lavachet, Les Brévières). Ice driving on frozen lake, ice diving, Grande Motte glacier summer skiing. Purpose-built, functional, passionate freeride/snowboard culture.

non_ski_activities.ice_driving: Tignes — drive a BMW or 4x4 on the frozen Lac de Tignes (Dec-Mar, book at Tignespace)
non_ski_activities.ice_diving: Tignes — ice diving in the frozen lake, guided with full equipment provided
non_ski_activities.swimming: Val d'Isère: municipal centre with 2 pools, sauna, steam room, fitness. Tignes: Tignespace wellness centre
non_ski_activities.ice_skating: Val d'Isère: Olympic outdoor ice rink. Tignes: ice rink

name: Espace Killy

lift_pass_pricing.note: 6-day pass = 7 days of skiing (7th day free). Early season (Nov 28-Dec 11) adult 6-day €402.30.
lift_pass_pricing.insurance: Carré Neige available. Pool entries included: 2 entries with 6-day+ pass.

suitability.beginners: Good — dedicated beginner zones at Val d'Isère (La Daille beginner area) and Tignes (Le Lac). Green runs above Tignes and on the Solaise sector. Lessons available with ESF.
suitability.intermediates: Excellent — the main Tignes-Val d'Isère link via the Tommeuses/Tovière pass opens up extensive blue/red cruising. Val d'Isère's Solaise sector has long blues. Tignes Val Claret to Le Lac is a gentle but fun valley run.
suitability.advanced: Outstanding — Face de Bellevarde (Olympic downhill, 1992), Grande Motte glacier blacks, Pisaillas glacier off-piste. The 'Sache' area below Bellevarde is famous for steep powder.
suitability.freeriders: World-class — Espace Killy is one of the world's great freeride destinations. Col de l'Iseran, Vallon de l'Iseran, La Sache, La Daille couloirs, and the run from Grande Motte to Tignes glacier.

signature_runs.name: Face de Bellevarde (Olympic downhill)
signature_runs.description: Legendary Olympic downhill course from 1992 — steep, exposed, above Val d'Isère

signature_runs.name: Grande Motte glacier descent
signature_runs.description: 3,456m to Tignes Le Lac via the glacier — snow-sure from November
